en.headline: Anne Imhof’s House of Swans opens at Tai Kwun with ballet performances
en.dek: The German artist’s first major solo exhibition in Asia runs through 3 January, pairing new installations, paintings and sound works with live ballet staged by Hong Kong Ballet dancers.
body: Tai Kwun Contemporary opened Anne Imhof: House of Swans on Friday, the first major solo exhibition in Asia by the 2017 Venice Biennale Golden Lion winner. The show occupies three floors of the JC Contemporary and F Hall galleries and continues until 3 January 2027.

The exhibition presents a commission of monumental new works that combine atmospheric scenography, sonic installations, oil paintings, bronze sculpture and video. Curated by Ying Kwok and Tiffany Leung, it juxtaposes classical forms with elements of urban infrastructure to explore bodily presence, restriction and authority.

Opening-week performances involving Hong Kong Ballet and an international cast took place on 25 and 26 September. Adapted ballet performances by Hong Kong Ballet dancers are scheduled on selected dates through November. Standard admission is HK$50, with concession tickets at HK$40. The galleries are open 11am to 7pm, Tuesday to Sunday.

zh.headline: 安妮．伊姆霍夫《天鵝社》大館開幕 香港芭蕾現場演出
zh.dek: 2017年威尼斯雙年展金獅獎得主首個亞洲大型個展於大館當代美術館展出至明年1月3日，結合裝置、油畫、聲音作品及香港芭蕾舞團現場演出。
body: 大館當代美術館周五起舉行安妮．伊姆霍夫《天鵝社》展覽，為這位2017年威尼斯雙年展金獅獎得主首個亞洲大型個展，展期至2027年1月3日，佔用賽馬會藝方及F倉三層空間。
展覽展出為大館委約創作的大型新作，結合氣氛佈景、聲音裝置、油畫、青銅雕塑及錄像。由郭瑛及梁棨芝策展，作品將古典藝術形式與城市基建元素並置，探討身體存在、限制與權力。
開幕周末已舉行香港芭蕾舞團與國際陣容的特別演出。展期內選定日子會有香港芭蕾舞團改編演出。標準票港幣50元，優惠票40元，展廳開放時間為星期二至日上午11時至下午7時。
